name: Southwest Power Pool active generator interconnection requests
what: Read the full active request list (GEN, ASGI and ERAS entries) and list every gas, oil, diesel or thermal entry in Kansas with its request number, capacity, point of interconnection, transmission owner, in-service date and study status, then decide each one under the add threshold: a new plant at announced, a new unit at a plant GEM has, a duplicate question, or a watch item with its case.

name: Southwest Power Pool expedited resource adequacy study (ERAS) material
what: Read the generator interconnection page and any ERAS cycle lists, study reports or interconnection agreement postings for the Kansas ERAS requests, and record whether an agreement has been signed (that makes a project pre-construction) and who the sponsor is.

name: Kansas Department of Health and Environment air permit public notices, live page and saved snapshots
what: Run or reuse harvest_permits_kansas.py (work/kansas_docs/notices.json and the saved notice pages) and read every air construction permit notice, draft permit and application for a gas or oil fired turbine, engine or boiler of 50 MW or more since 2022, including data centers and captive plants. A dead live link is read from its Wayback Machine copy and the copy is cited.

name: Kansas Register air permit and corporation commission notices
what: Search the Register issues since 2024 for Department of Health and Environment air permit notices and Corporation Commission notices that name a gas or oil fired power plant, and read each one.

name: Kansas Corporation Commission filings
what: Search the filing system for prior approval, predetermination, rate and siting dockets (docket codes PRE, STG, RTS) of Evergy Kansas Central, Evergy Kansas South, Evergy Metro, Sunflower, Midwest Energy, Kansas Power Pool and Kansas City Board of Public Utilities that add, convert or retire gas generation, and read the petitions and orders. The commission's press releases at https://kcc.ks.gov/ count too.

name: EIA-860M newest monthly generator file
what: Read the Operating, Planned, Retired and Canceled or Postponed sheets for Kansas in the newest file (work/eia/), and account for every gas or oil plant of 50 MW or more that GEM does not list, and every planned or canceled unit at a plant it does.

name: EIA-860 annual survey, ownership and plant tables
what: Read the newest annual Ownership and Plant tables for Kansas to confirm owners, shares and street addresses of gas and oil plants, and the Proposed Generator table for anything the monthly file lacks.

name: Evergy integrated resource plan updates (Kansas Central, Kansas South, Metro)
what: Read the 2026 update and the 2025 update at https://investors.evergy.com/2025IRPUpdate, the Missouri filings for Evergy Metro and Evergy Missouri West, and the US IRPs tab notes in work/irp_us-kansas.json. Every gas unit in a preferred portfolio is an add or an update; capacity only studied as an option is a watch item with case not_committed; a unit the plan places outside Kansas is a watch item with case other_scope.

name: Evergy newsroom and investor releases
what: Read every release since 2024 about new generation, data center agreements, plant retirements and conversions, and the quarterly earnings decks at https://investors.evergy.com/ for project names, capacities, sites and dates.

name: Sunflower Electric Power Corporation news and project pages
what: Read the news and project pages and any fact sheets for the Clifton replacement turbines, the Holcomb area combustion turbine request and any other new, replaced or retired gas unit.

name: Midwest Energy news and resource plan pages
what: Read the news and any resource plan or rate case material for new or retired gas generation at Goodman Energy Center or elsewhere.

name: Kansas Power Pool news and board material
what: Read the news, board meeting material and any project pages for Walnut Energy Center and any other new or retired gas or oil unit of its member cities.

name: Kansas Municipal Energy Agency news
what: Read the news and project pages for new or retired gas or oil generation owned by the agency or its member cities, including the McPherson request in the SPP queue.

name: Kansas City Board of Public Utilities plan and news
what: Read the 2024 integrated resource plan (saved at work/kansas_docs/bpu_irp_2024.txt, live copy at https://bpu.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/2024-BPU_IRP_Report-2024-FINAL.pdf), board meeting material and news for anything about the Quindaro diesel request in the SPP queue, Kaw, Nearman Creek and Quindaro retirements, and any new gas unit.

name: Liberty (Empire District Electric) resource plan and news
what: Read Liberty's news and its Missouri integrated resource plan filings for Riverton Power Plant additions (the EIA file lists two 13.5 MW Riverton units planned) and any other Kansas gas unit.

name: Environmental Integrity Project Oil and Gas Watch, Kansas power plant projects
what: Use work/ids_us-kansas.md from match_ids.py (the EIP sheet join) and the public facility pages for every Kansas power plant project EIP lists that GEM lacks, and chase each to the permit it cites.

name: Possible updates sheet, Kansas rows
what: Read the gas and oil plants tab through the work profile for every Kansas row and answer each one in a record or a coverage note. The state note says there were no open Kansas rows on 2026-10-21; confirm that.

name: Captive LNG sheet, Kansas rows
what: Use work/captive_us-kansas.json from captive_lng.py. Kansas has no LNG terminals with captive generation on the sheet; record that.

name: Data center gas generation in Kansas
what: Search trade press, Evergy releases and the state air permit notices for on-site gas generation at Kansas data center campuses (Beale Infrastructure, Digital Realty, Meta, Google, Panasonic and others). Every find is a watch item with checks [39] and case data_center_hold, never a new plant.
